definition: Universal Basic Compute — the monthly Φ120 Quanta stipend every registered person receives, framed as a compute dividend rather than welfare. Covers about three days of food in the Shelf. Used as justification to dismantle all other social programs.
origin: QFIC Resolution 2174-09 — technically a return on your fractional ownership of the global compute network
example: UBC hit today. That's three meals this week if I skip transit.
